items.title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
items.dek: Under the plans, only children over 15 would be able to set up their own social media accounts.

items.title: River home to 500 crocodiles chosen as Olympic rowing venue
items.dek: A river that is home to about 500 saltwater crocodiles is given the OK to host Olympic and Paralympic rowing and canoeing events at the 2032 Brisbane Games.
